1. Exemption allowed subject to all just exceptions.
2. The application stands disposed of.

3. This is a petition under Section 482 Cr.P.C., 1973 seeking quashing of FIR No. 340/2021 dated 12.07.2021 under Section 420/120B IPC, 1860 registered at Police Station Janak Puri and the proceedings emanating therefrom on the grounds of settlement.

sentences.text:
After discussions in cordial atmosphere during the mediation proceedings the parties have settled their disputes as under :-
(5.1) It has been agreed between the parties that the parties shall continue residing at the new accommodation i.e. H.No. C-2/285, first floor, Janakpuri, New Delhi-110058 for the betterment of their family consisting of two sons.

(5.2) It has been agreed between the parties that they wish to lead a life of dignity and self respect being emotionally connected with the family and wish to care each other by sharing household with each other.
(5.3) That both the parties will also cooperate each other to maintain peace and cordial atmosphere in the matrimonial house."

6. This Court has interacted with the petitioner as also with respondent no.2, who submit that keeping in view that they have a specially-abled son, they have decided to bury their differences and cohabit for the sake of the child.

7. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that in accordance with the terms of settlement,
divorce petition filed by the petitioner bearing HMA No. 853/2022 has already been withdrawn on 23.09.2023.
According to learned counsel all the terms of settlement have been worked out.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 22/10/2023 at 02:45:37 8.

Keeping in view the aforesaid fact that both the parties have buried their differences for the sake of their specially-abled son as also cooperate and take care of said son, this Court is of the considered opinion that any further proceedings would disrupt the matrimonial life of the parties as also the specially-abled son.

9. In that view of the matter, FIR No. 340/2021 dated 12.07.2021 under Sections 420/120B IPC,
1860 registered at Police Station Janak Puri and the proceedings emanating therefrom are quashed.
10. The petition stands disposed of.
TUSHAR RAO GEDELA, J OCTOBER 19, 2023 Aj
